The '''Tythos Ridge''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain range]] on [[Talss]], the largest of the [[Tython/Legends|Tython's]] continents.

==History==
A lush mountain range on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Tythos Ridge was a series of squat and jagged mountains that crossed Talss continent. Important to both the [[Je'daii Order]] and later the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Ridge was landing place of two of the [[Tho Yor]], around which formed the temples of [[Kaleth]] and [[Vur Tepe]]. Following the [[Force Wars]], the area was eventually conquered by the [[Flesh Raider]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of barbaric primitives abandoned by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] on Tython. Scouring the land and burning away all plant life, the ground was a smoldering ruin and bones littered the few paths carved across the landscape. When the Jedi Order relocated to Tython following the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shol Bestros]] proposed that a meditative retreat be constructed on the Ridge. Before such endeavors could come to fruition, the Flesh Raiders had conquered the area and made it inhospitable.<ref name="TOR" /> Instead, the Order established their [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] just northwest of the Ridge during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Coinciding with the Order's resettlement, a group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] refugees established the [[Kalikori village]] in the foothills of the Tythos Ridge.<ref name="NoP" />
